name: Ball valve
球阀
tagline: Start with isolation duty. Then specify the connection and operating conditions.
先明确隔离用途，再确认接口和使用工况。
overview: A ball valve is a quarter-turn valve type commonly considered for shut-off duty. Similar-looking bodies can have different port sizes, seats, connections and permitted services. Use this reference to prepare questions; select an actual model against its current manufacturer documents.
球阀是一类常用于关断用途的四分之一转阀门。外观相似的产品，通径、阀座、连接方式及允许使用的介质可能不同。本页帮助整理采购问题；实际型号应依据制造商最新资料选定。
fields: Duty
用途
State whether the requirement is isolation; confirm any control duty with the manufacturer.
说明是否用于隔离；如需调节用途，应向制造商确认。
Connection
连接方式
Record both ends: standard, nominal size and male/female thread or other joint type.
分别写明两端的标准、公称尺寸及内外螺纹或其他连接形式。
Wetted materials
接液材料
Request exact body, ball, seat and seal materials for the intended medium.
按实际介质索取阀体、球体、阀座及密封件的准确材料。
Operating envelope
使用工况
Provide medium, working pressure and temperature together; ask for the model's applicable rating curve.
同时提供介质、工作压力和温度，并索取对应型号的适用额定曲线。
Port and operation
通径与操作
Clarify full/reduced port, handle clearance and any locking requirement.
明确全通径或缩径、手柄操作空间以及锁定要求。
mistakes: Comparing nominal size alone while ignoring bore and end connections.
只比较公称尺寸，忽略实际通径和端部连接。
Treating a pressure figure as valid at every temperature.
认为标注的压力值适用于所有温度。
Assuming a brass appearance proves alloy grade or drinking-water approval.
凭黄铜外观判断合金牌号或饮用水认可。
questions: Which exact model and drawing match both end connections?
哪个具体型号及图纸与两端接口一致？
What is the pressure/temperature rating for our stated service?
对于所述使用条件，适用的压力与温度额定范围是什么？
Which seat and seal materials will be supplied?
实际供货的阀座及密封件采用什么材料？
Which model-specific documents and spare parts can be provided?
能提供哪些对应型号的文件和备件？
compare: A ball valve provides manual isolation; a check valve responds to flow direction. They address different requirements and are not direct substitutes.
球阀用于手动隔离，止回阀响应流动方向。两者解决不同需求，不能直接相互替代。

sources.title: Watts LFFBV-3C — manufacturer series reference
scope: Example of a documented ball-valve series, not the specification of every ball valve.
展示有资料支持的球阀系列，不代表所有球阀的统一规格。

name: Check valve
止回阀
tagline: Specify the flow direction, opening behaviour and installation position.
明确流向、开启特性和安装方向。
overview: A check valve is intended to limit reverse flow in a compatible system. Its operating behaviour depends on design and installation. Do not infer orientation or performance from the external shape, and do not treat a generic check valve as a certified backflow-prevention assembly.
止回阀用于在相容系统中限制逆流，其动作特性取决于设计及安装条件。不能根据外形推断安装方向或性能，也不能把普通止回阀视为经过认证的倒流防止装置。
fields: Flow direction
流动方向
Show intended flow on the piping drawing and confirm the body's direction marking.
在管道图纸上标明预期流向，并确认阀体上的方向标识。
Opening behaviour
开启特性
Ask which design is offered and whether opening-pressure and flow-loss data are available.
询问所供结构类型，以及是否有开启压力和流动损失数据。
Installation position
安装方向
Confirm permitted orientation for the exact model; do not generalize from another series.
核查具体型号允许的安装方向，不从其他系列直接推断。
Materials and service
材料与介质
Identify body, seat and spring materials where applicable, plus medium and temperature.
按具体结构确认阀体、阀座及弹簧材料，并明确介质与温度。
System requirements
系统要求
Confirm connection details, maintenance access and any required certified backflow protection separately.
分别确认连接细节、维护空间及所需的经认证倒流防护。
mistakes: Installing against the intended flow direction.
安装方向与预期流向相反。
Assuming every check valve permits vertical installation.
认为所有止回阀都允许竖直安装。
Using a generic check valve in place of a required backflow-prevention assembly.
用普通止回阀替代要求配置的倒流防止装置。
questions: Which installation orientations are permitted for this model?
该型号允许哪些安装方向？
What opening-pressure and flow-loss data apply to our operating range?
在我们的工况范围内，适用的开启压力及流动损失数据是什么？
How is service direction marked and checked before installation?
如何标识使用流向，并在安装前核对？
What inspection or maintenance procedure is specified?
规定的检查或维护程序是什么？
compare: Check valves address reverse-flow behaviour. Isolation valves and certified backflow assemblies have different purposes; compare against the actual system requirement.
止回阀针对逆流特性。隔离阀及经认证倒流防止装置具有不同用途，应根据实际系统要求比较。

sources.title: Watts LF600 — manufacturer series reference
scope: An example with documented installation options; these options are not a rule for other check valves.
提供安装方式资料的一个系列示例，其允许方式不代表其他止回阀。

name: Brass threaded elbow
黄铜螺纹弯头
tagline: Match the thread specification, not just the nominal size or appearance.
匹配准确的螺纹规格，而不只是公称尺寸或外观。
overview: A threaded elbow changes the direction of a pipe connection. Brass appearance does not establish the alloy, service suitability or thread standard. Identify the connection at each end and request the manufacturer's dimensional drawing before specifying a mating component.
螺纹弯头用于改变管道连接方向。黄铜外观不能证明合金牌号、介质适用性或螺纹标准。应分别识别两端接口，在指定配合件前索取制造商尺寸图。
fields: Thread standard
螺纹标准
Record the exact standard and thread form for each end; a shared size label is not enough.
分别写明两端准确的标准及螺纹形式，仅有相同尺寸标识并不充分。
End configuration
两端配置
Specify male/female ends, equal/reducing sizes and required elbow angle.
明确内外螺纹、等径或异径尺寸，以及所需弯头角度。
Material identity
材料身份
Request alloy designation and supporting material documentation where required.
索取合金牌号，并在需要时提供相应材质文件。
Dimensions
尺寸
Check overall envelope, wrench flats and available assembly space against a drawing.
依据图纸核查外形尺寸、扳手位及可用装配空间。
Sealing and service
密封与工况
Confirm the specified sealing method, medium and model-specific pressure/temperature limits.
确认指定密封方法、介质及对应型号的压力与温度限制。
mistakes: Assuming BSP and NPT can be interchanged because their labels look similar.
因标识相似而认为 BSP 与 NPT 可以互换。
Treating nominal pipe size as a measured outside diameter.
把管道公称尺寸直接当作实测外径。
Using a material or pressure rating from a different fitting or alloy.
套用其他管件或合金的材料或压力额定值。
questions: What exact thread standard and end configuration will be supplied?
实际供货的螺纹标准及两端配置是什么？
Can you provide a dimensioned drawing and material designation?
能否提供带尺寸图纸及材料牌号？
Which sealing and assembly instructions apply?
适用哪些密封和装配说明？
What evidence supports suitability for our stated medium and conditions?
哪些资料支持其适用于我们所述介质及工况？
compare: A threaded elbow is different from a compression elbow. Match the connection system and mating component before comparing suppliers or prices.
螺纹弯头与卡套式弯头不同。应先匹配连接系统及配合件，再比较供应商或价格。

sources.title: Swagelok B-4-E — manufacturer fitting reference
scope: A specific female-NPT brass elbow example; not a universal rating or interchangeability claim.
具体内螺纹 NPT 黄铜弯头示例，不代表通用额定值或互换性声明。

sources.title: Swagelok Pipe Fittings catalog MS-01-147
scope: Reference for identifying separate connection types and dimension fields; consult the current catalog revision.
用于识别不同连接形式及尺寸字段；请查阅当前版本的产品目录。
